preamble: No genuine change of the rhotic /r/ to the close-mid front vowel [e] has been found. The case previously filed here, r-vocalization in German and Austro-Bavarian, yields the near-open central vowel [ɐ] (a non-syllabic [ɐ̯] after long vowels), not [e]: hier is [hiːɐ̯], not [hiːe]. The correct outcome is the central vowel recorded under r_to_a and r_to_schwa.

examples.note: Coda r vocalizes to a central [ɐ̯] off-glide, not to a front [e]; Bavarian dialects show the same central outcome.
